title: Lord Byron's College Banned Dogs, So He Brought a Bear 🐻 #shorts
description:
When the poet Lord Byron was a student at Trinity College, Cambridge, the rules said no dogs. Nothing about bears. So he got a tame bear and walked it around the college on a chain. When he was asked what he meant to do with it, his answer (in his own letter, 1807): "he should sit for a fellowship."

Believe It Or Bear: true stories, twist endings. Follow for more.
